description: This file defines a mock class 'WrapsImplMock' for the 'WrapsImpl' interface, utilizing Google Mock to set up mock methods for system calls and wrapper functions related to filesystem and system operations. It facilitates unit testing by mocking system interactions such as setting mount points, executing commands, logging, and reading symbolic links.
external_methods: Mock methods: system, popen, pclose, syslog, setmntent, getmntent, v_secure_popen, v_secure_pclose, v_secure_system, readlink, time
